question: Display the total number of hours played by players from Europe in fighting games, grouped by game platform.
gold: SELECT P.Platform, SUM(P.TotalHoursPlayed) as TotalHoursPlayed FROM Players P JOIN GameDesign GD ON P.PlayerID = GD.GameID WHERE P.Country IN ('Germany', 'France', 'Italy', 'Spain') AND GD.Genre = 'Fighting' GROUP BY P.Platform;
pred:
SELECT 
    g.GamePlatform,
    SUM(p.TotalHoursPlayed) AS TotalHoursPlayed
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        gd.GameID,
        gd.GameName,
        gd.Genre,
        pg.Platform
    FROM 
        GameDesign gd
    JOIN (
        SELECT 
            GameID,
            MAX(GameID) AS MaxGameID
        FROM 
            GameDesign
        GROUP BY 
            GameName
    ) m ON gd.GameID = m.MaxGameID AND gd.Genre = 'Fighting'
    INNER JOIN Players p ON gd.GameID = p.GameID
    INNER JOIN Platforms pg ON p.Platform = pg.Platform
WHERE 
    p.Country IN ('Germany', 'France')
GROUP BY 
    g.GamePlatform;
